title: Watusi Horn Table

photo_details.alt: Three horned animal skulls are displayed in a black rectangular frame against a gray concrete wall; the skulls are positioned upright and angled slightly forward.
Three horned animal tusks protrude from a dark wooden frame, mounted against a light gray concrete wall.
Close-up of weathered animal tusks resting on dark wooden surface, angled diagonally with light falling across one tusk and casting shadows on adjacent tusks.

blurb: Handcrafted and reversible, this bedside table features two sets of Watusi cattle horns that can be repositioned to the user's liking. The horns contrast with a stark, asymmetrical tabletop to create a distinctive piece. Only two produced.
